ModMetaData.name: Local Tweaks (sammael)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Personal XML tweaks. Same list as the README on GitHub. - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients: decorative pneumatic tubes in vaults can be deconstructed (launch port and termini left alone). - Cyanobot's Plant Gen Patches + Biomes! Oasis: drops RG_Plant_JoshuaTree / RG_Plant_WingCactus from biome wild plants while ReGrowth 2 keeps those defs commented out. - Consistent Text: restores the Alpha Animals refinery recipe label (AA_ExtractUranium) its patch deletes. - Big Little Mod Patch + Linkable Groups: removes the abstract-parent and removed-def entries from its linkable groups that error at startup (the concrete beds are already covered). - Alpha Genes + Cherry Picker: removes the cherry-picked AG_DecreasedCommandRange gene from the random-mutation blacklist. - Flourish - Everyday Animations + Show Me Your Tools: children's floor drawing without Flourish's extra hands and body-lowering track. - Show Me Your Tools: no floating handheld spyglass while using a telescope (kept for skygazing). - Any scanner work giver missing it (Fortifications - Industrial radio): canBeDoneByMechs false as on the vanilla scanners, so mechs do not null-ref on their missing skills. - Rimsenal - Security Pack: range ring while placing the shard sentry, ULM cannon, barrage turret, cannon and rotary gun turret (the incinerator and graser turrets cannot use the vanilla ring). - Hauler's Dream: batch crafting gets the same Flourish animations and Show Me Your Tools tools as a normal bill. - Alpha Biomes + Vanilla Landmarks Expanded: chocolate and jadeite rock can be designated with "Mine vein". - Gulden Biome (Continued): capricorns butcher into vanilla horse meat, so "horse meat" no longer shows twice. - Biomes! Caverns: only one "nogtyl" per plant menu (the cave copy sows only in fungiponics basins, the marsh copy in growing zones). - Vanilla Furniture Expanded: the ergonomic chair can be placed over existing chairs and stools to replace them. - Hospitality: Casino + Det's Xenotypes - Boglegs + VFE Settlers: the tongo, billiards and faro tables are casino equipment like the poker table (pricing gizmo, earnings; guests pay per game, faro through Casino's own poker driver). - Blueprints - 1.7 Waylith + Better Architect Menu / Loading Screen Repository: Blueprints tab nested under Colony and the blueprint loading tip, as those mods do for the old Blueprints fork. - Core + VFE Tribals: hoopstone ring, Game of Ur board and floor painting stay buildable after the colony advances past Neolithic. - MSS Flavour Pack: the exorcism operation costs 10 gold as described, not 100. - Tweaks Galore: the "Trader available" alert no longer shows a literal {0} before the trader list. - Universal Blueprints Alpha Pack / DMS Pack: their Chinese-only "rim builder" childhood backstory in English. - Vanilla Persona Weapons Expanded: the persona-weapon psycast stat line reads "Gives ability" instead of the raw key VREA.GivesAbility (key only ships with VRE Archon). - Fortifications - Industrial + VFE Security: multi-barrel mortar launcher, field howitzer and field cannon keep their gizmo bar (Uninstall included) once player-owned; removes the world artillery comp that null-refs on them. - Better ground-penetrating scanner + Biomes! Caverns: the scanner can be placed under a roof; removes the Biomes roof check that the setting cannot.
